title: Frontend: Paginated List Component
summary: Build a reusable React pagination component with Prev/Next controls, a page indicator, an empty state and safe behaviour when its data changes.
problemStatement:
## Scenario The dashboard shows long lists (interview questions, applicants, ...). Instead of rendering hundreds of rows you are building a small reusable **`PaginatedList`** React component. ## Task Implement the default export of `src/PaginatedList.jsx`. Props: `items` (array of strings) and `pageSize` (number, default `5`). ## Required markup The tests find elements by the exact markup below - keep it. - The current page's items as `
  • ` elements inside one `
      `, in order. Nothing else is rendered as an `
    • `. - A `

requirements.title: Render the current page
requirements.description: Only the current page's items appear, as <li> elements inside a <ul>; the first page initially.

requirements.title: Navigate with Prev / Next
requirements.description: Clicking the buttons moves between pages.

requirements.title: Disable buttons at the bounds
requirements.description: Prev is disabled on the first page, Next on the last.

requirements.title: Handle the empty list
requirements.description: 'No items found' replaces the list and both buttons are disabled.

requirements.title: Stay valid when items change
requirements.description: A shrinking list never leaves the user on a non-existent page.
